topic.topic: Dinosaurs closer to us than to each other
topic.angle: Tyrannosaurus lived nearer in time to us than to Stegosaurus

card.title: T. rex is closer to you than to Stegosaurus

panels.text: Stegosaurus and Tyrannosaurus feel like they belong in the same picture. They don't.
Stegosaurus fossils date to between 155 and 145 million years ago.
Tyrannosaurus fossils are dated to 69 to 66 million years ago, in the late Cretaceous.
That leaves at least 76 million years between them. T. rex's own distance to today is 69 million years at most. So T. rex lived closer to us than to Stegosaurus.
